title: Backend scaling
blurb: How 2D drawElementImage(), WebGL2 texElementSubImage2D(), WebGPU drawElementImageToTexture() and a 2D-to-shared-WebGL copy bridge scale across element count, tile size and DOM mutation rate on your device.
question: Across element count (1, 8, 32, 64, 128), tile pixel size (64, 128, 256 CSS px at native DPR) and DOM mutation rate (0%, 10%, 100%), where are the throughput and latency crossover points between 2D drawElementImage(), WebGL2 texElementSubImage2D(), WebGPU drawElementImageToTexture() and a 2D-to-shared-WebGL copy bridge?
